type Scores = { [key: string]: string | number; [key: number]: number };
type Entries = { [key: number]: number; [key: symbol]: string };
function setScore(scores: Scores, key: string | number, text: string) {
  scores[key] = text;
  scores[key] ??= text;
  [scores[key]] = [text];
}
function setEntry(entries: Entries, key: number | symbol) {
  entries[key] = 'bad';
}
function setPattern(value: { [key: `a${string}`]: number; [key: `b${string}`]: string | number }, key: `a${string}` | `b${string}`) {
  value[key] = 'bad';
}
function setReadonly(value: { readonly name: number; [key: number]: number }, key: 'name' | number) {
  value[key] = 7;
}
function setTuple(value: [number?, ...string[]], key: 0 | 1) {
  value[key] = 1;
}
function setGeneric<K extends string | number>(scores: Scores, key: K, text: string) {
  scores[key] = text;
}
